cases.input: A study tries to pin a method while Analysis Method has no allocated identifier.
cases.expect: The unresolved reference fails and is never defaulted or silently accepted.

cases.input: A WM-KNW-007 claim omits mood or kind, or a deontic claim carries approval or effect.
A causal claim lacks one gate or its kind is not permitted by the pinned method revision.
cases.expect: The claim cannot complete as causal and is reduced to associational.

cases.input: A study records a deviation outside the method revision applicability.
cases.expect: The pin remains, method warrant is lost and affected causal claims become associational or withdrawn.

cases.input: Two interpretations are ranked and one receives an explicit pinned defeater.
cases.expect: Ranking changes neither claim; the defeated rival remains resolvable.

cases.input: A study pins an effective method revision which is later deprecated and retired.
cases.expect: Only the effective revision accepts the new pin; later transitions preserve issued outputs.

cases.input: A finding receives a changed study, method, sample or data pin.
cases.expect: A successor is created; predecessor and its pinned report remain unchanged.

cases.input: A recommendation is accepted or rejected, while another decision has no recommendation antecedent.
cases.expect: Decision content and occurrence remain separate; recommendations stay unchanged and non-authoritative.

cases.input: A report introduces a conclusion absent from its pinned findings.
cases.expect: The report is rejected and re-rendering pinned content remains deterministic.

cases.input: A system attempts to mint Analytical Study identity from WM-ACT-034.
cases.expect: The attempt is rejected; only WM-ACT-036 is the study master.

cases.input: Two studies over different populations and parameters pin one effective method revision.
cases.expect: Parameters remain study-owned and cannot overwrite the reusable definition.
